key_insight: PRISM automates multi-phase CT subtraction for RCC by converting routine scans into registered, color-coded digital subtraction volumes with minimal manual interpretation.
clinical_relevance: This workflow could make renal tumor enhancement assessment more consistent and faster by standardizing phase comparison and highlighting subtle enhancement patterns for review.
method: Automated DICOM phase classification and loading
Deep-learning isotropic upsampling with RIFE plus kidney segmentation with TotalSegmentator v2
Rigid + affine + B-spline registration in SimpleITK, followed by dual-channel subtraction visualization
evidence_signal: Across 200 registrations in five patients and five experiments, the team identified settings that preserved quality while reducing compute time, including a 40 mm B-spline grid and 5% metric sampling.
watch_item: Performance was evaluated on a small patient set, so broader validation is needed before assuming the same registration settings and subtraction thresholds will generalize across scanners and anatomy.
paper_title: PRISM: Phase-Resolved Isotropic Subtraction Mapping for Automated Multi-Phase CT Digital Subtraction Angiography
